rationale.consistency: Perfectly follows Caddy module conventions, reuses existing action types, and aligns with other filters.
rationale.edge_cases: Correctly handles unparseable lines, exact name matching, multiple identical cookies, and verbatim suffix preservation.
rationale.scope: Implements exactly the requested Set-Cookie filter with all three actions and Caddyfile support, and nothing else.
rationale.readability: Clear, idiomatic Go with well-named variables, straightforward loop logic, and concise Caddyfile parsing.
rationale.robustness: Gracefully handles parse errors, type assertions, and missing attributes; preallocates slice and avoids panics.
rationale.maintainability: Highly decoupled logic; reusing the existing action struct ensures changes to cookie actions apply here.
